camel_example: aliyun smartag AttachCcnInstanceToCen --region cn-hangzhou --RegionBindingList '[{"CidrBlock":"192.168.60.0/24","RegionId":"cn-hangzhou","TransitRouterId":"tr-wz9h1y152p7bajkehs5a3"}]' --CidrAllocationMode UNIFIED --CcnId 'ccn-isdjvvkexkrpk*****' --CenId 'cen-joimmi1s2ob3rdxw79' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Subnet '172.16.55.0/24' --version 2018-03-13 --method POST --force
description_en: Attaches a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 云连接网绑定云企业网
kebab_example: aliyun smartag attach-ccn-instance-to-cen --ccn-id 'ccn-isdjvvkexkrpk*****' --cen-id cen-joimmi1s2ob3rdxw79 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subnet 172.16.55.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachCcnInstanceToCen

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) to attach
parameters.name: ccn_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance to which you want to attach the CCN instance
parameters.help_zh: 指定要授权的云企业网实例的ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance. You can invoke the DescribeRegions operation to query the regions supported by Smart Access Gateway and the corresponding region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Internet CIDR block used to attach the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) to the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网绑定云企业网使用的互联网段
parameters.name: subnet

fields.help_en: The custom CIDR block for each region when the CidrAllocationMode parameter is set to PER_REGION
fields.help_zh: CidrAllocationMode模式为PER_REGION时，给每个Region自定义的网段
fields.name: cidr_block

fields.help_en: The region ID of the transit router
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the transit router used for forward routing
fields.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The list of transit routers to be newly attached to the CCN instance
parameters.name: region_binding_list

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block allocation mode. Valid values: - PER_REGION: Custom CIDR blocks are allocated for each region. - UNIFIED: A unified CIDR block is allocated
parameters.help_zh: 网段分配模式，PER_REGION每个Region各自自定义，UNIFIED统一分配
parameters.name: cidr_allocation_mode
